title: Uncertainty Principles for the Number Theoretic Transform
summary: Motivated by polynomial identity testing with exponentials (Li and Wu, ITCS'26), we study uncertainty principles for the number-theoretic transform (NTT). We show that the NTT satisfies strong sparsity tradeoffs: For every fixed prime $q$ and for all but finitely many primes $p \equiv 1 \pmod q$ every nonzero $f\in \mathbb F_p^{\mathbb Z_q}$ and its number-theoretic transform $\hat f$ satisfy \[ |\mathrm{Supp}(f)| + |\mathrm{Supp}(\hat f)| \ge q+1. \] Thus, a $k$-sparse function has transform support at least $q-k+1$.
